value.rationale: The icosahedron is a canonical symmetric planar graph and matching extendability is the defining property of this complex. Its exact torsion-free mixed sphere wedge and non-shellability are nontrivial, not deducible from the known ordinary complex, and contrast with that same graph’s ordinary complex three-torsion. It provides a reproducible structural benchmark without claiming a general planar classification.
